assertionSteps.title: 1. Given Admin A uses subject "admin-a" with role "FMO_ADMIN" in an isolated authenticated browser
2. And the controlled Import Map fixture records the initial grid rows and persisted values
3. And the Import Map grid has record "101" owned by "FMO_ADMIN"
4. And the baseline fixture data defines "Module Name" as "container-086"
5. And the baseline fixture data defines "Path" as "https://fixture.example/case-086.js"
6. And the originally loaded "Module Name" value is "OLD"
7. When Admin A clicks the button labeled "Edit" in the Import Map grid row with "Record Id" "101"
8. Then the dialog titled "edit ID: 101" is visible on the Import Map administration page
9. When Admin B completes a controlled concurrent update setting "Module Name" to "NEW"
10. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Module Name" with "STALE" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
11. And Admin A fills the textbox labeled "Path" with "https://fixture.example/case-086.js" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
12. And Admin A clicks the button labeled "Update" in dialog "edit ID: 101"
13. Then the alert with severity "error" in the portal snackbar displays the agreed message for a stale-record error
